sources.quote: External dimensions Approx. 275×53×305 mm (width × height × length) (excludes largest projection)
Input/ Output Super-Speed USBx (USB 3.0) port × 2 AUX port × 1 Networking Ethernet (10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, 1000BASE-T) ×1
AV output HDMI out port DIGITAL OUT (OPTICAL) port

notes: Sony's 2013-09-25 release, CUH-1000A series. Sony labels the third axis 'length' (width × height × length); it is recorded as depth, the front-to-back axis of a console standing on its feet. Excludes the largest projection.

ports = the release's Input/Output, Networking and AV output rows. Sony's table says 'USB' without naming the receptacle; it is filed as usb_a, the only USB receptacle in the §3 vocabulary before USB-C, and the reader should treat the A as Sony-unstated. The AUX port (the PlayStation Camera connector) has no §3 kind and is not filed. HDMI and optical counts are not printed; each is filed as 1 (Sony names a single 'HDMI out port' and 'DIGITAL OUT (OPTICAL) port'). The table's Power row is 'AC 100-240V' (internal supply) and an AC power cord is included, but the inlet is not named: features.power_inlet null, no power_in item.
The later CUH-1200 revision is a different model and is not covered here. media: loading mechanism not stated, uncovered. external_ids: Wikidata Q106360845 ('original version of the PS4').
